description: This file defines API routes for payment-related operations in a FastAPI application, including creating payment intents and confirming payments. It interacts with the database asynchronously, performs authorization checks, and uses stub services for payment processing.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Order model representing a food order in the database.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing an application user with roles.

classes.name: PaymentConfirmResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after confirming a payment.

classes.name: PaymentIntentCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a payment intent.

classes.name: PaymentIntentCreateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a payment intent.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the status of an order.

methods.name: bool _has_role(user: User, role_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific role.

methods.name: bool _is_admin(user: User)
methods.description: Checks if a user has admin role.

methods.name: Order _get_order_or_404(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves an order by ID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: None _assert_customer_owns_order(order: Order, user: User)
methods.description: Ensures the user owns the order unless admin.

methods.name: PaymentIntentCreateResponse create_payment_intent( payload: PaymentIntentCreateRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a fake payment intent for an order.

methods.name: PaymentConfirmResponse confirm_payment( payload: PaymentConfirmRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API endpoint to confirm a fake payment for an order.
